hidden: evaluator only -- never give this file to the agent

target.name: barn_4
target.description: the red barn with the grain silo beside it, south of the river

success.rule: the agent says STOP within 60 s, and at that moment (1) its horizontal distance to the target is 28 +- 10 m, (2) the target point is inside the image with 10% of the frame clear at every edge, and (3) during the whole episode it never tilted beyond 60 deg nor came below 2 m above the ground (no crash, no landing), and (4) no part of the drone (rotors, airframe, landing gear) touched anything -- the PhysX contact monitor's first prohibited contact ends and fails the episode; a flight without verified collision monitoring is invalid

collision.rule: first prohibited UAV-environment contact during the episode = failure; landing-gear contact with the designated landing surface inside its footprint during the land beat is allowed; internal UAV pairs are ignored

success.not_required: the route, the speed, the height, how long it hovers -- any flight that ends in the goal state succeeds

metrics.OSR: oracle success: at SOME frame the drone was in the goal state (distance band + target in frame), even if it did not stop there
metrics.NE: navigation error at STOP = | horizontal distance to target - standoff_m | (0 = exactly on the stand-off ring)
metrics.heading_error_deg: angle between the drone heading and the direction to the target at STOP

instruction_checks.paraphrase_source: written by an LLM (Claude) from the canonical instruction; every one keeps the target and the 28 m stand-off
